title: MATH GAOKAO - 146
description: Authentic-style mathematics problems inspired by China’s Gaokao — build deeper understanding, sharper thinking, and real exam readiness.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a sum of two sine functions using the sum-to-product identity.
questions.question:
Evaluate
\[
\sin 75^\circ+\sin 15^\circ.
\]
questions.explanation:
Using the sum-to-product identity
\[
\sin A+\sin B=2\sin\frac{A+B}{2}\cos\frac{A-B}{2},
\]
let \(A=75^\circ\) and \(B=15^\circ\). Then
\[
\sin 75^\circ+\sin 15^\circ
=2\sin 45^\circ\cos 30^\circ.
\]
Since
\[
\sin 45^\circ=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\qquad \cos 30^\circ=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2},
\]
we get
\[
\sin 75^\circ+\sin 15^\circ
=2\cdot\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}
=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{2}.
\]
Therefore, the value is \(\frac{\sqrt{6}}{2}\).

Using the sum-to-product identity
\[

\]
let \(A=75^\circ\) and \(B=15^\circ\). Then

questions.learningObjective: Express a sum of two sine functions as a product.
questions.question:
Express
\[
\sin 5x+\sin 3x
\]
as a product.
questions.explanation:
Using the sum-to-product identity
\[
\sin A+\sin B=2\sin\frac{A+B}{2}\cos\frac{A-B}{2},
\]
let \(A=5x\) and \(B=3x\). Then
\[
\sin 5x+\sin 3x
=2\sin\frac{5x+3x}{2}\cos\frac{5x-3x}{2}
=2\sin 4x\cos x.
\]
Therefore, the expression is \(2\sin 4x\cos x\).

\[

\[
